title: Comparisons to previous cars and early driving impressions
summary: This topic centers on owners comparing the car with previous vehicles or wishing certain aspects were better, alongside a smaller set of clearly positive early ownership impressions.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe being pleased with the car so far and, in some cases, preferring it to previous BMWs or earlier cars.

mixed.summary: The mixed review pairs overall vehicle discussion with frustration about MyBMW app stability, disappearing trip data, and updates changing settings without clear notice.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mainly contain short comparative statements about the car, manuals, driving feel, sound, or desired features being better or worse, but the limited fragments do not always make the overall stance clear.

limitations: Most sampled fragments in this topic are undetermined and very short comparative remarks, which limits confidence about the underlying sentiment.
The cluster mixes several subjects, including overall car comparisons, driving feel, manual quality, sound, and app or feature-learning comments, so it is not fully coherent.
Examples are insufficient to determine whether references to 'better' consistently describe the current car or another vehicle.
